en.t: Corporate tax embezzlement implicates city government.
Industrial giant builds an academic city.

units.source_text: “中止作业相继发生，工业总评议会发声”……

en.t: Work stoppages occur one after another, and the General Industrial Council speaks out.
Mother strangles her second son, then takes poison.

units.source_text: “小汽车偷盗事件频发，新生活样式催生新犯罪？”……

en.t: Car thefts frequent; is a new way of life producing new crimes?

units.source_text: “三年里，匿名少女送花给警局”……

en.t: For three years, an anonymous girl sends flowers to the police station.

units.source_text: “东京奥林匹克运动会因经费预算产生争议”……

en.t: Tokyo Olympic Games sparks controversy over its expense budget.
Today, two more girls are ambushed by thugs.
Sleeping pills prey upon campus youth.
The stock market feels its first chill.

units.source_text: “著名次中音萨克斯管演奏家保尔·杰克逊访问日本”……

en.t: Famous tenor saxophonist Paul Jackson visits Japan.

units.source_text: “南非再次发生暴乱，死伤二百八十人”……

en.t: Riots break out again in South Africa, leaving 280 dead or injured.

units.source_text: “女贼出入小偷学校，不收学费，测验合格即发毕业证书”。

en.t: Female thief frequents a school for thieves; no tuition is charged, and graduates receive diplomas after passing an exam.
